protocol.metric: Total variation between normalised occupancy in a masked window plus visible context; 0.75 m Gaussian measurement smoothing on a 1 m grid.
protocol.rule: Every duration up to limit: n>=30, acceptance>=0.6, TV improvement>=0.05, P95 gap RMSE<=1.5 m. Model selected before examining held-out match.
